configuration.FFN_and_head_initialization: torch Linear defaults; override head bias from fit ratio median
configuration.attention_implementation: explicit QK softmax probability-dropout AV; no compression/SDPA
configuration.attention_projection_initialization: torch Linear defaults; Q/K/V/Out bias zero
configuration.epoch_selection: fixed last epoch; no query labels or early stopping
configuration.gradient_accumulation: microbatch weighted L1 sum / actual optimizer-group row count
configuration.loss: fit-recency weighted MAE in million TWD
configuration.optimizer_parameter_groups: all parameters, one group, no decay exclusions
configuration.sample_weight_normalization: saved fit-global normalization; no batch renormalization
